messages:
nina-finance: Orchid sent invoice INV-0427-2026 via EDI but our AP system didn't find a PO number. amount $12,340. autopay scheduled tonight — should we block?

kevin-ap: @nina-finance paste invoice detail please. if no PO we need to stop payment and notify vendor immediately. autopay cutoff is 22:00.

nina-finance: ```
INV-0427-2026
- Monthly managed support (Apr) $7,200
- Onboarding professional services $4,540
- Emergency hardware rental $600
TOTAL $12,340
```
No PO on the PDF and the EDI PO field is blank.

sam-purchasing: We do have PO-88921 open for Orchid (managed support + onboarding) but it caps at $11,800. hardware rental not included.

lee-ops: Orchid swapped in a loaner node during the incident last week. Ops asked them to proceed, but I didn't sign off on extra hardware cost. @diane-eng any approval?

diane-eng: I didn't approve extra cost. For emergency stuff we need a post-facto CO.

kevin-ap: I'm putting a hard hold on Orchid in the AP system and disabling autopay for tonight. @sam-purchasing can you ask Orchid to either: 1) reissue invoice with PO-88921 referenced and remove $600, or 2) provide an approved change order for the rental? We can't pay without PO match or CO.

vendor-orchid: Thanks for the heads up. We'll draft a corrected invoice INV-0427-2026A referencing PO-88921. Alternatively we can upload a signed change order for the rental if that's faster. Which do you prefer?

sam-purchasing: Either is fine. CO would be ideal to keep one invoice. I'll create a change order request in Coupa: https://procurement.redwood.internal/co/88921/req. @diane-eng please review.

diane-eng: Approved the CO in Coupa. signed electronically. :white_check_mark:

kevin-ap: Once we receive the reissued invoice or the CO, I'll clear the hold and send to payment queue. Noting potential late fee risk but we can negotiate waiver if needed.

nina-finance: Emailed Orchid and cc'd procurement & AP. holding message sent with copy of PO and CO link.

vendor-orchid: CO received and invoice refiled as INV-0427-2026A with PO-88921 in the header. Upload sent to ap@redwood.com.

kevin-ap: Got it, matching now. will route for payment on next cycle. closing hold.

nina-finance: tagging this as resolved. thanks all.
file_note: Orchid invoice missing PO; hardware rental added post-incident; hold placed and CO requested, resolved with reissued invoice.
